setup.script: if(location.pathname!=='/watch'||!document.querySelector('#player video'))throw new Error('watch analyzer fixture unavailable');return {ok:true};

activation.script: const ctx=arguments[arguments.length-1],base=ctx.postActivation,video=document.querySelector('#player video'),wait=async()=>{const end=Date.now()+5000;while(Date.now()<end){if(Number(ImprovedTube.storage.analyzer?.[base.date]?.[base.hour]?.[base.channel]||0)===base.before+1)return true;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}return false;};video.pause();if(!await wait())throw new Error('extension analyzer consumer did not persist exact +1 delta');return {ok:true};

prerequisites: The re-entered watch fixture must expose a playing real video and resolved channel metadata.
A real pause must reach the extension consumer and persist exactly +1 at the current date/hour/channel; runtime restores the exact analyzer collection.

postActivation.script: const video=document.querySelector('#player video'),channel=ImprovedTube?.elements?.yt_channel_name?.__data?.tooltipText,date=new Date().toDateString(),hour=new Date().getHours()+':00',before=Number(ImprovedTube.storage.analyzer?.[date]?.[hour]?.[channel]||0);if(!video||video.paused||!channel)throw new Error('playing analyzer consumer fixture unavailable');return {ok:true,verified:true,date,hour,channel,before,wasPaused:false};
